Folks,

I updated the checklist with architecture-side notes and uploaded a short cost sketch (vpc-onprem-cost-estimate.pdf). Key architectural risks that need explicit decisions:

1) KV cache placement for on-prem customers: we can either run a local KV service per-customer (operationally heavier) or rely on encrypted remote KV with strict egress controls. If security requires no egress, the cost and ops go up significantly.
2) Quantization and kernel support: some on-prem GPU stacks may not support our preferred quantized runtime; we need a compatibility grading and fallback model selection strategy in the matrix.
3) Network topology for hybrid mode: whether we require a full transit gateway (procurement-heavy) or a lightweight SSH/VPN for initial pilots.

Owners (suggested):
- Landing zone templates: Infrastructure (karthik)
- Runtime defaults & certs: Platform (stephanie)
- On-prem ops playbook & runbooks: SRE (vivek)
- Security & KMS exceptions: Security/Product (monica)

Attachments: [Attachment: vpc-onprem-cost-estimate.pdf (pdf)]

I can block 0.6 FTE for infra work in Q2 if we get explicit sign-off on the network topology (transit gateway vs VPN).

Karthik
